label: Getting started
description: How to consume agent-ui in your own app: the workspace packages and the one load-bearing CSS import order.

label: Accessibility
description: Roles/state via ElementInternals, focus + roving tabindex, landmarks, live regions, reduced motion, and how a consumer labels a control.

label: Testing guide
description: The jsdom/browser vitest harness, the shared @agent-ui/shared/testing/dialog-polyfill stub, when a real-engine run is required, and the ElementInternals/ARIA assertion idiom.

label: Theming
description: One theming subtree, three live axes: scheme (light/dark), scale, and density.

label: Token reference
description: Every colour role across every family, the numbered tonal primitives, plus the dimensional ramp.

label: Sizing & density
description: Control geometry is an explicit (scale x size) lookup, never a multiplier; density touches spacing only.

label: Forms
description: A form-provider coordinating three field-wrapped controls, one working example narrated concern by concern.

label: Registration & sign in
description: Sign-up and sign-in forms over ui-form-provider/ui-field, wired to a real in-memory identity-mock-transport in a dev/preview build (GH #490, ADR-0176).

label: Magic link sign in
description: Request a magic link, confirm the demo's stand-in for clicking the emailed link, and reach the signed-in state — the SAME in-memory identity-mock-transport as Registration & sign in (GH #490, ADR-0176).

label: One-time code sign in
description: Request a one-time code, enter it into ui-otp-field (auto-verifying on completion, no submit button), resend with a real per-email cooldown, and reach the signed-in state — the SAME in-memory identity-mock-transport as Registration & sign in (GH #490, ADR-0176).

label: Social sign in
description: Choose a provider, walk a simulated redirect + callback round trip, complete or cancel the sign-in, and reach the signed-in state — the SAME in-memory identity-mock-transport as Registration & sign in (GH #490, ADR-0176).

label: Onboarding
description: Advance/back/skip through a first-run step shell (Welcome / Workspace name / Choose a theme) with a discrete step-N-of-M progress readout, gated on an existing demo session — the SAME in-memory identity-mock-transport as Registration & sign in (GH #490, ADR-0176).

label: Onboarding checklist
description: The checklist-onboarding composition recipe: card + list + checkbox + progress bound to a plain signals store, matched to onboarding-first-run.flow.json — the mint-last proof that no ui-stepper is needed (GH #961).

label: Card grid + drawer edit
description: The card-grid + edit-via-drawer composition recipe: ui-grid + ui-card + ui-drawer, a buffered record form, and a page-owned dirty-state/discard-confirm convention (recipe-level, not a fleet ADR) — extracted from the agent-admin entry-list/entry-form shape (GH #917/#947, PR #948; GH #965).

label: Sticky TOC content layout
description: A long-form article + a scroll-spy'd ui-nav-rail sidebar, swapped to a ui-select below the ADR-0150 compact line — the TOC-corpus composition recipe (heading-derived entries, the new scrollSpy trait), and the mint-last proof that no ui-toc control is needed (GH #964).

label: Account settings
description: A generic account SettingsSchema rendered by the shipped ui-settings — view preferences, edit and save one through the SettingsStore — behind a must-be-signed-in gate reading the SAME in-memory identity-mock-transport as Registration & sign in (GH #615, ADR-0176).

label: Composition patterns
description: The consumer-assembly pattern map (build-time parsed from the composition-patterns skill's references) plus every shipped recipe page and the deeper compose-procedure skills (GH #1042).

label: Which component when
description: A quick chooser between components that overlap in purpose, condensed from the A2UI catalog's own guidance.

label: Events
description: The closed seven-event vocabulary, UIElement.emit's bubbles/composed/cancelable mechanics, a per-control event inventory derived from every descriptor's events[], and a live ui-select + ui-switch event log.

label: Changelog
description: The shipping summary of agent-ui's milestones, newest-first.

label: Super Shell
description: ui-super-shell is the shell-archetype family's grammar ceiling (M5): a two-level recursive frame — header/rails/panes/canvas/footer, all optional, header-hosted per-side collapse.

label: Chat Shell
description: ui-chat-shell is a thin ui-super-shell preset for the chat archetype: header, nav-pane, content — no options side.

label: Workspace Shell
description: ui-workspace-shell is a thin ui-super-shell preset for the full outer-level workspace grammar: header, global-nav rail, nav-pane, section-nav, content, options-pane, options-section, global-options rail, footer.

label: Master Detail
description: ui-master-detail is a docked list | detail arrangement over the shipped ui-split, drilling into one record.

label: Settings
description: ui-settings is a sections rail + panel, composing ui-master-detail for a schema-driven settings surface.

label: Nav Rail
description: ui-nav-rail is ONE navigation-rail primitive whose closed collapse enum picks its own narrow disposition: a top-layer flyout, a plain list, icon-only popovers, or anatomy-only drill-in.

label: Router
description: @agent-ui/router: a memory-first SPA router whose route state lives in a kernel signal.

label: Surface Host
description: ui-surface-host is the M2 mount/stream seam — wraps one @agent-ui/a2ui RendererHost, standalone-usable (SPEC-R3), with the GH #805 disable-on-action mechanics.

label: Conversation
description: ui-conversation is the M2 thread + composer + per-turn narration primitive, with an opt-in declarative composition mode (ADR-0180) for its header/dialog/composer bands.

label: Highlight
description: @agent-ui/code/highlight: a swappable syntax-highlighter registry plus seven bundled, zero-dependency tokenizers.

label: Data
description: @agent-ui/data: a headless SaaS data layer — the DataSource seam, signal-backed resource()/mutation()/paginated(), the ./gateway client onion, and the ./stream Streamed<T> bridge.

label: Traits
description: @agent-ui/components' three published trait subpaths (./traits/overlay, ./traits/list-reorder, ./traits/scroll-spy) plus ./dogfood-frame — the (host, opts) => cleanup behaviours below controls, derived from source.

label: View Transitions
description: ADR-0183's shared withViewTransition seam + its four opt-in surfaces (ui-super-shell, ui-surface-host, ui-drill, ui-router-outlet) — the opt-in law, per-surface tables, and the GH #1005 named-morph proof.

label: Entry List
description: mountEntryList()/entry-data.ts — the headless ordered-entry-list primitive (ADR-0132/ADR-0164) reused by every agent-admin capability kind and the card-grid-drawer recipe, plus composer-options.ts and agent-admin-persona-patch.ts coverage.

label: Persistence
description: @agent-ui/shared's StorageAdapter seam (ADR-0193, proposed) — the async get/set/delete/keys interface, a live localStorage-tier demo, the IndexedDB tier, choosing a tier, and how it relates to ui-settings' own SettingsStore and to @agent-ui/data's in-memory cache.

label: Agent Admin
description: ui-agent-admin is a three-pane ui-split (chat canvas, prompts, settings) over ui-conversation and ui-settings, one shared SettingsStore, live-apply with no external model dependency.

label: Agent Admin App
description: The full ui-agent-admin composition at real viewport scale, no docs-site chrome — the six-persona A2UI-showcase surface exactly as it would ship in production.

label: Devtools Harness
description: The chat & A2UI dev/debug harness (ADR-0200): three swappable backends behind one AgentTransport seam, the raw DevtoolsEvent NDJSON timeline, per-surface render-confirm verdicts, and capture export/import.

label: Persona Library Pattern
description: Export a whole authored configuration as a shareable file, re-import it as a NEW library entry, never an overwrite — the reusable pattern behind agent-admin's persona export/import (GH #406).

label: Agent Schema
description: The agentConfigSchema() config surface and the AgentConfigSnapshot turn-time read ui-agent-admin actually uses, derived live from agent-admin-schema.ts, plus pointers to the persona/entry-library/preset shapes.

label: Layout Primitives
description: The structural layout family — ui-row, ui-column, ui-list, ui-grid — sharing the UIContainerElement base and gap/align/justify props.

label: A2UI Canvas
description: A live A2UI payload rendering a real button through the shipped renderer, round-tripping its click as an action message.

label: A2UI Catalog
description: Every component the default agent-ui A2UI catalog declares, rendered live through the real renderer.

label: A2UI Dynamic List
description: A2UI v1.0's data-bound children: one ChildList template rendering one live element per array row.

label: A2UI Generative Form
description: One A2UI payload becomes a complete, validated, accessibly-labelled form, submitting a typed aggregate action.

label: A2UI Patterns
description: Five UIs an agent actually emits: a settings form, a destructive confirmation, a wizard, and more.

label: A2UI Gallery
description: Every composition on the A2UI example-seed shelf, rendered live through the same renderer.

label: A2UI Streaming
description: An agent streams a screen one JSONL line at a time; each line applies the moment it arrives.

label: A2UI Live Agent
description: A live-agent chat app: the agent's A2UI stream renders into a real canvas that round-trips actions as the next turn.

label: A2UI Chat
description: One scrolling chat log where the agent's narration streams live and its A2UI surfaces render inline, persisting across turns until closed.

label: A2UI Authoring Guide
description: How to author a catalog row and an example payload, the two things that teach an agent this fleet.

label: A2UI Agent Guide
description: The producer half (ADR-0137): the transport seam, the bounded produce() loop, buildSystemPrompt(), the meta-line channel, and a runnable consumer example.

label: GenUI Chat Demo
description: A chat app rendering agent-authored HTML/CSS/JS through the sandboxed ui-sandbox-frame containment host — a recorded backbone of canned turns, one exercising the action bridge round-trip.

label: GenUI Corpus Eval
description: The B3 judged pack-idiom eval (PRD §8 m3): index.json's own m3 summary + record table, a real ui-sandbox-frame per judged record on disclosure open — honest empty state until Kim's named manual run.

label: SaaS Data Workbench
description: A data table + filter toolbar + record-edit modal + agent-summary card composed entirely from published fleet primitives inside ui-workspace-shell — the M-A flagship composition proof (GH #461).

label: Support Dashboard
description: Stat cards + a bar chart + a read-only table + an agent-summary card composed entirely from published fleet primitives inside ui-workspace-shell — the fleet's second SaaS composition, proving the data-app posture generalizes (GH #499).

label: A2A Tic-Tac-Toe Arena
description: Two agents play tic-tac-toe through a deterministic referee, an isolation-proven Agent2Agent match.

label: A2A Concepts & Demos
description: The A2A corpus made readable: one card per admitted record, the wire shape it teaches, and why.

label: A2A Artifact Feed
description: A conversation carried over A2A, some turns bearing live A2UI artifacts.

label: Gallery
description: Every shipped component, browsable and filterable in one live grid.

label: Changelog
description: Every milestone as its own searchable record, loaded lazily as a separate per-entry index.

label: Decision Records
description: Every ratified ADR as its own searchable record, loaded lazily as a separate per-decision index.
